name: teslaway
tagline: Finds used Teslas near a ZIP code and emails you the shortlist
description: Point it at a ZIP code and say whether you want a Model 3, Model Y, Model X or Model S, and it searches US used listings for cars that fit. What it finds lands in your inbox as a plain list, with the details you need to decide which ones are worth a closer look.
author: cicerougc
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
